summary: Retained real-GPU runtime evidence and accounting pass integrity checks; the bounded action is real and enforces max one bypass, but performance effects do not satisfy the prespecified two-block condition and support descriptive measurement only.

gt_and_reference_provenance.details: Actual GPU/native runtime event measurement; no task-quality GT is required for timing authenticity. Frozen input/source hashes match. Model bytes are absent locally, so shard hashes were checked only against the retained verification record.

score_normalization_and_accounting.details: No self-normalization. Raw and relative values coexist; all request denominators, token streams, distributions, failure counts, and mutually exclusive time partitions independently reconcile.

result_existence.details: Both archive hashes/bytes/member counts match; all declared episode triples and support files exist and byte-match extracted readback; all 24 raws are COMPLETE.

code_reachability.details: Frozen code hashes match, live scheduler monkey-patch is reached, and raw native first admissions independently reproduce every recorded bypass charge including same-step order.

scope_and_fairness.details: FCFS, SPT, reverse order, and all-short no-op control are fair for a pilot, but there are only two engine blocks on one reused workload/model/host and no Oracle, significance, task-quality, HTTP, or multi-GPU evidence.

evaluation_type.details: Real runtime measurement without task-quality GT; auxiliary prefill result is structural observation only.

no_future_information.details: Policy reads only current native waiting requests, known prompt lengths, arrival ranks, and past actual admission counts; every acted-on request had already arrived.

identity_alignment.details: All request/document/token-hash/arrival identities match prepared workloads; all cumulative output tokens and receipt timestamps reconstruct exactly.

same_step_bypass_semantics.details: Independent reconstruction matches native result insertion order and recorded same-step charges; bounded max is exactly one in both mixed blocks.

separate_policy_state.details: Each arm executes a complete independent episode and drains request/KV state before the next; no future trajectory is shared.

common_observation_overhead.details: All arms execute queue capture/mutation and ledger instrumentation; arm-specific policy work remains inside measured request/wall time.

post_hoc_selection.details: All prespecified formal and warmup episodes are retained and included according to the frozen analysis rule; no favorable run was selected.

findings.finding: The bounded action works, but its short-TTFT and overall effects do not satisfy the frozen two-block success rule.
README and several STATUS timestamp/progress fields remain stale relative to completed raw results.
Both stderr logs retain an SM/CUDA capability warning, despite CUDA 13.0, exit code 0, and complete cells.

claims.claim: The bounded policy executes and limits actual first-admission bypasses to one in the tested mixed trace.
The policy descriptively attenuates SPT long-request p95/max completion penalty in both blocks.
The policy preserves a stable short-TTFT benefit versus FCFS.
The policy has stable net request, throughput, SLO, or wall-time benefit.
The policy preserves task quality or generalizes to production/HTTP/multi-GPU EP.

resurrection_condition: A preregistered new natural request/arrival regime showing a materially different fairness problem; no threshold or seed scan.
uncovered: Independent rehash of absent model-weight bytes
Statistical generalization beyond two engine blocks
Full vLLM correctness or security audit
trace_omitted_reason: Explicit user/repository rule prohibits automatic .aris trace generation
